summary: Use :ansopt: and :ansretval: to reference options and return values (optionally with =value), and :ansoptref: and :ansretvalref: to link them with custom titles.
questions: How do I reference a module option in RST docs?
How do I link to a module's return value with my own link text?
How do I show an option with a value in docs?

answer_card.title: Referencing options and return values
answer_card.answer_md:
- `:ansopt:`ansible.builtin.file#module:path`` references an option; add `=/root/.ssh/known_hosts` to show a value.
- `:ansretval:`ansible.builtin.stat#module:stat.exists=true`` for return values.
- `:ansoptref:`provide a path <ansible.builtin.file#module:path>`` and `:ansretvalref:` for custom titles.
- `:ansopt:`foo`` without FQCN gives markup but no link.
